# JSY Crystal Jewelry

> One-stop custom bracelet solution supplier in Shanwei, Guangdong, China. JSY Crystal works with partner factories and workshops in Ketang, takes the overseas order, and coordinates natural-stone beads (and other bead materials on request), charms, tags, gift boxes, cards and packaging — with QC and consolidated shipping — so buyers deal with one partner. Exclusive overseas agent of those partner factories; main line is natural stone beaded bracelets for custom, OEM, private label and wholesale.

Key facts (from this website):
- Positioning: one-stop custom bracelet programs — beads, charms, accessories, engraved or logo tags, gift boxes, cards and packaging coordinated together.
- Products: natural stone beaded bracelets — amethyst, rose quartz, strawberry quartz, citrine, clear quartz, gold rutilated quartz, phantom quartz, super seven, golden and silver obsidian and more (20+ stones).
- Also: custom natural-stone beaded bag charms, keychains, wristlet keychains and phone charms, with tassels, logo tags and packaging. Car charms and beaded chains or straps (bags, phones, glasses, lanyards) on request. Natural stone should be kept away from sweat, pool water and long water exposure; stainless steel parts are waterproof and tarnish-free.
- Bead sizes 6 / 8 / 10 / 12 mm; elastic or knotted cord; custom length, mixes, charms, logo tags and packaging.
- Minimum order: 10 pieces per order, freely mixed. Branded packaging/tags may have separate minimums, confirmed per quote.
- Samples before bulk; sample fees and shipping quoted per project.
- Pricing depends on quantity, design and packaging; we quote each inquiry.
- Bulk production about 15–30 days after sample approval; DHL/FedEx about 7–10 days, sea freight about 25–35 days.
- Main line is natural stone bracelets; for other bead materials or crystal items, buyers can ask and the team checks what can be made or sourced.
- Contact: marketing@jsycrystal.com · inquiry form https://jsycrystal.com/inquiry/ · reply within 24 hours

## Who we serve
- Custom for end clients: travel/tour group gifts, corporate & annual-meeting gifts, boutique exclusive designs
- Wholesale for distributors: bulk orders + private label packaging and tags
